title: Synagogue
summary: The synagogue was a local gathering place for Scripture reading, teaching, prayer, and community instruction among the Jews.
background: In the New Testament, Jesus and the apostles often enter synagogues to teach, reason from Scripture, and proclaim the kingdom. Synagogues helped shape the public setting for Scripture-centered instruction.
teachingHelp: When a passage takes place in a synagogue, emphasize the setting of Scripture reading and public teaching, not merely a religious building.
sources: Alfred Edersheim, Sketches of Jewish Social Life in the Days of Christ (1876).
International Standard Bible Encyclopedia, original 1915 edition.
